tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Satisfactory completed one similar nature Man power Supply of (DRIVERS or LOADERS or Helper or CLEANERS) supplying to govt department offices of Contract Value not less than Rs 34.00 Lakhs in any one of the last 03 years i.e., 2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26
Karnataka Labour Department Registration Certificate (Valid certificate of Agency Issued by the Competent Authority)

Liquid assets and /or availability of credit facilities of not less than 30percent amount of tender Credit lines/ letter of credit/ Banker certificates from scheduled banks for meeting the fund requirement As per Bid Document
Non Black listed self declaration by any department certificate
